watch.summary: The streamer reacts to a vlog of esports players playing a trivia game, expressing disbelief when a player fails to guess a well-known movie.

beats.what: Streamer watches vlog footage of an esports event backstage.
Pro player puts a phone on his forehead to play a Heads Up style guessing game.
Teammate gives clue 'movie about a guy who ages in reverse' and the player fails to guess it.
Streamer expresses mild shock that the player did not know the movie.

watch.author: pro_player_in_footage
watch.key_line: That's crazy that this guy doesn't know... That's Brad Pitt I think.
watch.why: The streamer reacts with mild disbelief as a pro player misses an easy pop culture clue during a casual game. While relatable, the clip lacks a major comedic escalation or punchline.
